name: Christian Werner
features: fair skin, short dark hair parted at the side, deep-set grey eyes, narrow lined face, prominent straight nose, wiry compact build, quiet mechanic’s bearing
bio: A Daimler mechanic and test driver from 1911 who only began racing when Mercedes turned seriously to the sport in the 1920s. In 1924 he won the Targa Florio and the Coppa Florio on the same day, the first driver from outside Italy ever to take the Targa, and the works team never fielded a steadier pair of hands. Ill health ended his career and he died at Bad Cannstatt in 1932, aged 40.
